title: True Love is Being Able to Divorce?
synopsis: The rumor of a coming change in Shanghai's housing policy has caused a flood of couples wanting to get divorced, in order to take advantage of a loophole in the system.

fullText.simplified:
能离才是真爱？

    最近，上海市民政局都快忙不过来了，因为来离婚的人实在太多了。但是在这些将要离婚的人们脸上看不到一丝悲伤，相反，他们看起来十分开心，这是为什么呢？
    原来这和上海市流传的住房政策有关。有传言，上海将要加紧限制购买住房的政策，以后，一个家庭只能购买一套房子，一年之内离婚的还要按已婚情况处理。所以很多人为了买到两套房子，都急着离婚。因为离了婚，法律上就不算一个家庭了，男方可以买一套房，女方也可以买一套房。
    很多夫妻其实只是在法律上离婚，实际上还是生活在一起，生活和离婚前没有什么区别。有的夫妻甚至说：“能离才是真爱”。
fullText.traditional:
能離才是真愛？

    最近，上海市民政局都快忙不過來了，因為來離婚的人實在太多了。但是在這些將要離婚的人們臉上看不到一絲悲傷，相反，他們看起來十分開心，這是為什麼呢？
    原來這和上海市流傳的住房政策有關。有傳言，上海將要加緊限制購買住房的政策，以後，一個家庭只能購買一套房子，一年之內離婚的還要按已婚情況處理。所以很多人為了買到兩套房子，都急著離婚。因為離了婚，法律上就不算一個家庭了，男方可以買一套房，女方也可以買一套房。
    很多夫妻其實只是在法律上離婚，實際上還是生活在一起，生活和離婚前沒有什麼區別。有的夫妻甚至說：“能離才是真愛”。

raw.synopsis: The rumor of a coming change in Shanghai's housing policy has caused a flood of couples wanting to get divorced, in order to take advantage of a loophole in the system.
sentence_translations: True Love is Being Able to Divorce?
Recently the Civil Affairs Bureau in Shanghai has more work than they can deal with, ..
.. since too many people come to get divorced.
But in the faces of those who come to get divorced, there is not a trace of sadness.
On the contrary, they seem quite happy. Why is that?
This has to do with the news of a housing policy that spread in Shanghai.
Rumor has it that Shanghai will tighten restrictions for buying apartments.
Soon you will only be able to buy one apartment per household, ..
.. and those who got divorced within just the last year will still be counted as married.
So a lot of people hurry up and get divorced in order to buy two apartments.
If they are divorced, they are no longer considered a family by the law.
So the husband can buy one apartment and the wife can buy one.
A lot of married couples only get legally divorced, but in reality they still live together.
Their life is exactly the same after the divorce as before.
Some married couples even say: “True love is being able to divorce”
